purpose: Pre-M62 EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN baselines for the canonical legacy query set. Re-run post-migration in T012 — any planner delta fails CI.
note: Queries are pinned by SQL string. The T012 regression harness applies migrations 001..061 (pre-M62), captures plans, applies M62, captures again, and asserts: (a) plans are identical to these baselines AFTER M62; (b) none of the four new SPEC-006 indexes (idx_projects_workspace_area_slug, idx_projects_one_sync_owner_per_repo, idx_projects_one_triage_per_workspace, idx_tasks_area_routing_backfill_pending) appears in any of the legacy plans.

queries.name: poller_legacy_selection
queries.sql: SELECT id, github_repo, github_sync_enabled, github_default_branch, workspace_id FROM projects WHERE github_sync_enabled = 1 AND github_repo IS NOT NULL AND status = 'active'

queries.name: task_select_by_id_workspace
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ? AND workspace_id = ?

queries.name: task_list_by_workspace
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE workspace_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: agent_queue_capacity
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM tasks WHERE assigned_to = ? AND status = 'in_progress' AND workspace_id = ?

queries.name: agent_lookup_by_name
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM agents WHERE name = ? AND workspace_id = ?

queries.name: task_match_by_repo_issue
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE github_repo = ? AND github_issue_number = ? AND workspace_id = ?
